title: Version number and release notes
items: New: the version number now shows on the camera screen (top bar on computers) and in Setup. Click it to see what changed.
New: "What's new" in Help lists every update with its date and time and what it added or fixed.

title: Owner tools
items: New: Setup → Owner tools, unlocked with an owner passphrase, can delete anyone's saved setup (whatever its PIN), old files and suggestions.
New: the owner can mark suggestions Accepted or Not accepted, with a note.

title: Suggest a feature
items: New: 💡 Suggest button. Send an idea, change or problem; everyone can see the list.
New: each suggestion shows Pending, Accepted or Not accepted.

title: Help and FAQ
items: New: ? Help page with how-tos and answers to common questions.

title: Emoji pop-up pictures
items: New: 18 built-in emoji (🚨 👀 🦖 …) to choose as a camera's pop-up picture.

title: Easier to find watch areas
items: Fix: watch areas now show right under their camera in Setup → Cameras, where you can rename them, add them to a group, edit or remove them.

title: Right-click menu, area views, recorded sounds and more
items: New: right-click a camera (long-press on Android) to change its name, star, motion, sound, picture or watch area.
New: a watch area becomes its own zoomed "· area" view; the full view stays too.
New: record your own alert sound with the microphone.
New: fun pop-up pictures that appear when a camera has motion.
New: put the menu bar at the top, bottom, left or right.

title: Personal setups, parked cars, stacked pop-ups
items: Change: settings are personal to each browser. Save your own copy to the server under your name and a PIN; nobody else's setup loads automatically.
Fix: parked cars no longer trigger pop-ups unless they actually move.
Change: pop-ups stack on the right (newest bigger, up to 10) with Dismiss all; starred cameras pulse red instead of taking over the screen.

title: Motion history and sounds
items: New: 🕘 History window with 14 days of motion pop-ups.
New: desktop notifications when the page is in the background.
New: choose a sound per camera, or upload your own.

title: Watch areas
items: New: draw a watch area on a camera so motion only looks there, with a zoomed view for the AI.

title: Power saving
items: New: after a while with no activity the screen goes dark and video stops, while motion watching keeps running.

title: Better motion detection
items: Fix: fewer false alarms from things that stay put, like a flag's shadow or a hydrant.
New: Not real button to ignore a spot.
Fix: people walking past are caught more reliably.
New: "See what the AI sees" test in Setup.

title: First release
items: Sign in through Wave Cloud, pick, rename and hide cameras, and build groups.
Rotate through a group's cameras full screen.
Phone-friendly layout.
Motion pop-ups for people, vehicles and animals on starred cameras.
The page updates itself when a new version is published.
